annotations.text:
Start here.

Click any glyph in the three bars to cycle it live / needs-attention / off. Pick the treatment that survives a glance, and the rest of the canvas follows it — the other artboards are drawn in Option A.

The Connectivity pane with the endpoint form gone.

Five core connectors as tiles; click one to open its ceremony in the sheet. The Endpoints panel is collapsed by default and has no Save button.
Everything on the right is live — change the sentence selects, hit the refresh glyph to generate a password, tap a fill chip to populate the daemon URL.
